vamo-setup.title: Get started
vamo-setup.summary: Guided setup in the AI tool you already use: your agent works out the tool and what it allows, connects Vamo the way that keeps working (the MCP server with sign-in by default), adds the skills, and runs a first search as a short tutorial. Also covers setup codes and direct API access for your own code.

vamo-troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
vamo-troubleshooting.summary: When Vamo stops working, your agent finds out why: which route it is on, three checks in order, what each error means, and what to send Vamo if it cannot fix it.

vamo-search.title: Search
vamo-search.summary: Find engineers by what they built, from a technology, a company, a repository, a place, one person or a whole job description. Includes turning intake notes into a search spec, covering a broad topic without missing the famous items, and query phrasings for 50 domains.

vamo-enrich.title: Enrich
vamo-enrich.summary: Learn more about people you already have, wherever they came from: candidates in an applicant tracking system such as Ashby, LinkedIn profiles, applicants, a spreadsheet. A strength read, location, LinkedIn, current role, contact details, screening for real engineering work, a one-page summary and a full research report.

vamo-outreach.title: Personalized outreach
vamo-outreach.summary: Personalized technical outreach grounded in what each engineer built and linked to the problem the team is hiring for. Two openings per person, subject lines, a short follow-up sequence, a quality check, and merge fields for a sending tool. A person approves every message.

vamo-workflows.title: Workflows
vamo-workflows.summary: Vamo together with the other tools your agent can reach: new matches posted to Slack, applicants screened and written back to Ashby or another tracking system, drafts left in Gmail for approval, a weekly search into a sheet, and your own sourcing agent. Who owns what, the record that moves between steps, and the rules for runs that repeat.
